title: VTC Groups — Requests — List — payload
description: A group manager lists requests to join the groups they manage, pending by default. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

cursor.description: An opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`, bound to the caller and the filters; a responder MUST NOT accept a cursor it did not issue.

limit.description: The most items to return, at most 200; the responder chooses a default and MAY return fewer.

Response.title: VTC Groups — Requests — List — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/groups/requests/list/0.2 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/groups/requests/list/0.2#response.

fields.description: The requester's directory fields projected for the caller, as vtc/directory/entries/show would.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token for the next page; pass it back as `cursor`. Absent on the last page — never `null`.
